title: Jack Schlossberg Slams “Fiction” ‘Love Story,’ Urges Ryan Murphy to Donate to JFK Library, “Do Something About Getting Trump Out of Power”
summary: The Kennedy scion, whose late uncle John F. Kennedy Jr. and wife Carolyn Bessette are portrayed in the FX TV show, is continuing to speak out against what he calls a "grotesque display of someone else's life" and saying that Murphy "knows nothing about what he's talking about."
